01 · Why act now

Every missed call is a client who booked someone else.

તમારો દિવસ હજી પણ આવો જ ચાલે છે?

A new client searches on a phone, compares three salons in seconds and books the one they can find, trust and reach fastest.

  • Your Google profile is thin or missing: they scroll past you.
  • There is no website: they cannot see your services and prices.
  • Booking means a call nobody answers: they message the next salon.
  • Rent, salaries and products live in a notebook: you cannot say what the month earned.

03 · Google Maps

People who search “salon near me”
decide in seconds.

Google Maps પર લોકો તમને શોધી શકે છે?

What we do

  • Claim and complete your Google profile: categories, services, hours, photos
  • Link it to your Gujarati + English website
  • Google-review link and a printable QR for your counter
  • Map and directions on your site; local schema and sitemap
  • Optional monthly care: weekly posts, review-reply drafts, report

What we will not promise

No one can promise a top position. Google says: “There's no way to request or pay for a better local ranking on Google.” Local results depend on relevance, distance and prominence. We make your profile, reviews and website strong, and report what changes.

Maps પર ટોચના રેન્કની ગેરંટી કોઈ આપી શકતું નથી. અમે પ્રોફાઇલ, રિવ્યૂ અને વેબસાઇટ મજબૂત બનાવીએ છીએ.

08 · Promises

You risk very little. Here is why.

તમારા માટે જોખમ ઓછું: લેખિત ભાવ, લોંચ પહેલાં ડિઝાઇનની મંજૂરી, અને ડેટા તમારો.
Our six promises
  • A fixed price in writing, with the scope
  • You approve the design before launch
  • Honest status on every module: ready, built with you, or later
  • No ranking promises, and no invented results
  • Monthly Google care: cancel any time after 3 months
  • Your content, photos and client data stay yours
Questions owners ask
Is it expensive?
Starter is ₹12,999 once and ₹5,999 a year, about ₹500 a month. About 2 extra bookings a month at a ₹900 ticket covers year 1.
Will I really get more customers?
No one can honestly promise that. We make you easier to find, trust and book, and send a monthly report so you can see what changes.
I'm not technical.
Send us your photos and services. We build it, in Gujarati if you like, and finish with a 30-minute handover call.
What if I don't like the design?
You see a preview and approve it before launch. If it is still not right after two rounds, we stop and refund your start payment.
I already use an app.
Keep it. We build your website and Google presence around it, and do not touch your billing.
Do I own my website and data?
Your content, photos and client data are yours. Hosting and source-code terms are explained in writing before you start.
